notes:
Summary / call notes:
- Prospect: large payments platform, heavy peak-hour trading windows. Sensitive PII + KYC data; strong residency needs.
- Use cases: reranking fraud signals (low-latency), embeddings for historical transaction search, summarization for case reviews.
- POC notes: engineering liked batching/cost profile on dedicated, but saw 95th/99th tail spikes during synthetic load tests.
- Security told us: 'We need vendor to be in our approved list and provide ISO docs + KMS integration. Replicate already has a standing SOW with procurement.'
- Procurement comment: 'Budget reallocation and existing vendor relationship wins here.'
- Internal changes: VP Data (our champion) departed in Dec; no replacement yet — momentum dropped.
- Competitive: Replicate beat us on perceived ease of contract and existing compliance attachments; Together was discussed by ML team but procurement flagged higher cost. Fireworks was trialed by one squad but lacked required residency.
- AE action history: pricing concessions offered (10% first-year discount), private env trial extended 2 weeks, SE Diego logged latency mitigation suggestions (cache priming, KV cache tuning).
- Quote from SE: 'We improved median but saw edge-case tail that may need infra-side tracing; asked for access to internal replay logs but customer refused for compliance.'
- Current: closed-lost. Recommend capture post-mortem (attached drive links) and re-open in 6 months once procurement/VP role stable.
